header.running_head: Some General Du'aas that Rasulullaah ﷺ Made

blocks.text: and do not help others against me. Plan in my favour and do not plan against me. Guide me and make guidance easy for me and assist me against those who oppose me. O my Rabb! Make me one who is grateful to You, who remembers You, who is not wary of You, who obeys you and who turns towards You. Accept my repentance, wash away my sins, accept my du'aa, make my testimony firm, guide my heart, steer my tongue and remove ill feeling from my heart"[^1]

blocks.arabic_text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ مُوْجِبَاتِ رَحْمَتِكَ وَعَزَائِمَ مَغْفِرَتِكَ وَالسَّلَامَةَ مِنْ كُلِّ إِثْمٍ وَالْغَنِيْمَةَ مِنْ كُلِّ بِرٍّ وَالْفَوْزَ بِالْجَنَّةِ وَالنَّجَاةَ مِنَ النَّارِ
blocks.text:
Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) narrates that amongst the du'aas that Rasulullaah ﷺ made was:
"O Allaah! We beg You for everything that attracts Your mercy and forgiveness. We also beg You for safety from every sin, for inspiration to do every good, for the success of Jannah and safety from Jahannam."[^2]

blocks.arabic_text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوْبَنَا وَظُلْمَنَا وَهَزْلَنَا وَجِدَّنَا وَعَمْدَنَا وَكُلُّ ذٰلِكَ عِنْدَنَا
blocks.text:
Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Amr (RA) narrates that Rasulullaah ﷺ used to make du'aa saying:
"O Allaah! Forgive the sins and wrong we do in jest, in earnestness and on purpose, all of which we are guilty of"[^3]

blocks.arabic_text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِيْ مَا أَخْطَأْتُ وَمَا تَعَمَّدْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ وَمَا جَهِلْتُ وَمَا تَعَمَّدْتُ
blocks.text:
Hadhrat Imraan bin Husayn (RA) narrates that the du'aa Rasulullaah ﷺ made most frequently was:
"O Allaah! Forgive the wrongs I do in error and on purpose, those that I have done secretly and those I have committed openly, those committed in ignorance and those done intentionally"[^4]

Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) says that Rasulullaah ﷺ used to make du'aa saying:
"O Allaah! Make my character beautiful just as You have made my appearance beautiful"[^5]

blocks.arabic_text: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَاهْدِنِي السَّبِيْلَ الْأَقْوَمَ
blocks.text:
Hadhrat Ummu Salamah (RA) reports that Rasulullaah ﷺ used to say:
"O my Rabb! Forgive me, have mercy on me and guide me to the most upright path"[^6]
